job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities:



Lead end-to-end AI product development from solution design to production deployment.
Design and implement AI/LLM-based applications using Python, OpenAI/Claude/Gemini APIs, RAG, Vector Embeddings, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph).
Architect scalable, secure, and cloud-native solutions using Azure/AWS/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Provide technical oversight for AI-assisted application development, ensuring solutions are designed for long-term scalability, maintainability, and enterprise adoption.
Guide and mentor a team of 4-5 engineers, manage sprint execution, and remove technical roadblocks.
Collaborate with clients to understand business requirements, propose technical solutions, provide project updates, and ensure successful delivery.
Drive production support, performance optimization, security, monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Own the end-to-end product ionization process, including architecture reviews, risk assessments, approvals, cloud deployment, and operational handover.
Drive production support, performance optimization, security, monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.



Required Skills & Qualifications:



5-7 years of software engineering experience with at least 3-4 years in Generative AI/LLM solution development.
Strong expertise in Python, REST APIs, AI/ML, LLMs, RAG, vector databases, coding agentic frameworks.
Experience with cloud platforms, containerization, DevOps, and enterprise architecture.
Excellent leadership, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale AI products.
Bachelor's degree or Masters degree in any related field.
job.location: Hybrid - Bengaluru, Delhi / NCR, Mumbai (All Areas)
